topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture themes, contextualises them within the course, and outlines the expected learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages that drive Darwinian clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how tissue differentiation hierarchies and stemness properties dictate which cell types are susceptible to initiating cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental exposures, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions provide permissive conditions for tumor growth.

topics.label: Techniques for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the experimental, sequencing, and spatial omics technologies used to study tumor heterogeneity and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis and Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesise the multifactorial drivers of cancer evolution discussed throughout the lecture and conclude the session.
